title: So SO Mixed feelings
text: [[VIDEOID:d60361c7d5a67fce9d1a4b4bbaefb5ae]] I have used every item sent in my Allure beauty box. I used this service for three months. I needed make up items and they send mostly skin / facial care items which I need but I signed up thinking cosmetics. I canceled my service and may return at some point as it is a good value but like I said at this point I need more cosmetics. Thanks Allure. I did enjoy my subscription.
label: neutral
